triggers.description: Fires when any trigger matches; once per event. At most one webhook:incoming trigger.

Does not affect who can trigger the automation.

teams_reply_access.description: Who may reply into existing sessions from Microsoft Teams threads: devin_users (linked Devin accounts only) or teams_users (anyone in the organization's connected Microsoft tenant; the default). Does not affect who can trigger the automation.

template_id.description: Create-only provenance marker; resolve ids via the templates endpoint. When set and tools.mcp_servers is omitted, the template's required_mcps apply.

script_check.description: Optional script Preflight check: a script that runs before the actions and decides per trigger whether to proceed, skip, or fan out. Validated and written with the automation.

llm_check.description: Optional LLM check: a fast model that decides per trigger event whether the automation runs.

operations.name: Update a blueprint's contents, position, source and or commit build settings
operations.description: Partial update for a single blueprint. Does NOT auto-trigger a build. Fields honored: - ``contents`` — writes a new YAML version for the blueprint. - ``position`` — sets the repo-tier blueprint's execution position. Returns ``400`` on an org-tier blueprint (those have no position). - ``source`` — switches the repo between ``git`` and ``database`` mode. Root repo-tier blueprints only. ``{"source":

contents.description: If set, replaces the blueprint's YAML body with a new version.

position.description: If set, updates the execution position of this repo-tier blueprint. Positions are not required to be unique; ties are broken arbitrarily by the server when sorting for execution.

source.description: If set, switches the repo's blueprint source. Only accepted on the repo's root blueprint (scoped blueprints inherit it). 'git' pulls .devin/blueprint.yaml from the default branch (404 if absent) and cannot be combined with 'contents'; 'database' keeps the current YAML (or 'contents', if given) and stops syncing from the repo. No-op when the blueprint is already in that mode.

build_on_default_branch_commit.description: If set, turns building the environment on each push to the default branch on or off. Only accepted on the root blueprint of a github.com repo. Every such push queues a build.

report_check_runs.description: If set, turns reporting each commit build as a GitHub check run on or off. Enabling it requires 'build_on_default_branch_commit' to be on.
